auditReason: Site Stats owns a shared metrics collector rather than a UI. This prospective target remains unfulfilled until its real series can be captured through a consuming Core metrics dashboard.

entries.title: Site Stats content totals in the Core metrics dashboard.
entries.notes: Prospective, currently unfulfilled evidence target. Capture only from a consuming Core metrics dashboard with capell-app/site-stats installed. Seed multiple UTC days of Core metric samples collected by ContentTotalsMetricsCollector so both content.pages_total and content.sites_total show non-flat, labelled trends. The dashboard is host-owned; do not describe it as a package-owned Site Stats UI and do not substitute generic hero or catalogue artwork.
entries.useCase: An administrator verifies that the installed Site Stats collector supplies page and site inventory history to Capell's shared metrics dashboard.

notes: No screenshot is currently claimed or promoted. This optional contract records the authentic integration evidence required before Site Stats can add Marketplace media.
